lines.text: In Burningum's office.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I can't quite understand why you're taking so long.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I've already handed over the optical camouflage, as well as every piece of new technology.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And from what I've heard, the weapons and equipment they produced from it are more than sufficient.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Yes, there's enough to arm every Nikke in the Ark and still have some left.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Things are going exceptionally well. Once again, I can't help but be impressed by Eden's technology.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Then why aren't they proceeding with

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: the Third Surface Reclamation War?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It's not that simple. The biggest issue is that we lack a legitimate justification.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Why would reclaiming the surface require any justification?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Wasn't that humanity's goal all along?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The Ark is stable for now. We've got everything we need,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: so there's no reason to take unnecessary risks.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I hear a terrorist attack has taken place.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Well, it'll be sorted out soon. We already have a plan in place.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: From the Ark's perspective, it's not a serious problem. So there's no need to rush into war.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Then why go to such lengths to stockpile weapons and supplies? Anyone would think you were about to start a war immediately.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Let's just say it's meant to enhance stability within the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Being in a stable state means you have a bit of leeway, don't you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have you considered that there might not be another chance if you let this one slip?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I see you're impatient.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You seem unusually impatient. That's not quite like you.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I heard you went to the surface once. What exactly did you do there?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do I have to report that to you too?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What did you see that makes you so eager to kick off the Third Surface Reclamation War?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Looks like you've even put a stop to that strange broadcast.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Your intentions are so painfully obvious.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Once the Third Surface Reclamation War begins, you'll be standing at the vanguard.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The Ark will apply pressure to the Nikkes during the war, urging them to destroy more Raptures and forcing them beyond their limits.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Lives will be regarded as nothing more than numbers.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: After all, this is our third attempt, and failure is not an option.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: And that's when you step forward.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You'll rack up countless achievements during the surface reclamation war.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: With your overwhelming strength and unique charisma, you'll captivate not only the Nikkes but also the public.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Using that influence, you'll stand before the persecuted Nikkes,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: and lead them to Eden, the paradise on the surface.
Burningum presses a remote control, and a video starts playing on the monitor.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have you heard that

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: paradise exists on the surface?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: A place where there's no such thing as exploitation or dishonesty.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Where you can be whoever or whatever you want to be, free from limitations.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: A place where there is no oppression or deprivation.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Where you'll always have a safety net, no matter what.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Eden, the last paradise on the surface,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: welcomes you all.
Burningum stops the video.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Eden welcomes you all, huh?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: want to take the Ark for yourself.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: During the Third Surface Reclamation War, you'll lead the weary Nikkes to Eden, this so-called paradise.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You'll leave the empty Ark behind and make Eden the new Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's your plan, isn't it?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You have quite the imagination.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Well, I suppose so. When you're in this position, there's nothing to do but imagine.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Let me speculate a bit further.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The fact that you stopped that broadcast advertising Eden

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: suggests that your plan to turn it into the new Ark has failed,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: especially after what you went through on the surface.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Something must have happened to Eden.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I can only imagine two possibilities: Eden has been destroyed

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: or you've been cast out.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: In the worst case, it could be both.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Should I give you a round of applause? I never expected you'd have such a vivid imagination.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Well, I won't stop you if you want to.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: As for why you're rushing to start the Third Surface Reclamation War in the middle of all this, I'll need to think that over.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: But if your plan is to at least become the Ark's hero in a spirit of despair because you have nothing left,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'd be disappointed in you in more ways than one.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That will never be the case.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Good, I hope it's nothing more than my imagination.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Anyway, if you're not going to give me a proper explanation,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: just know that the Ark has absolutely no reason to hurry.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We can always wait until the technology is fully mastered before making a move.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're not going to get anywhere just by preparing yourselves.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're not immortal.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It doesn't matter if I die. There will be plenty to carry on after me.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Risking the fate of the Ark just for a personal achievement during my tenure is sheer nonsense.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Unless you can give the entire Ark and me a reason to push forward the Third Surface Reclamation War,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: this conversation ends here. I have a guest waiting outside.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Very well.
Phew...
*Whirr*
The door to the Deputy Chief's office opens,
and Dorothy steps out.
Dorothy...
Dorothy glances at me for a moment,
then walks past without a word.
Through the open door, I catch sight of Deputy Chief Burningum.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: C-come in.
... Excuse me.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: H-have a seat.
Thank you.
I sit down,
and Deputy Chief Burningum takes the seat across from me.
... He stares at me intently.
The intensity of his gaze makes me want to look away, but I force myself to hold his eyes.
He shifts his glance slightly and then speaks.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Th-there's no need to drag this out. I-I'll just...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Enough of this foolishness.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'll speak plainly.
Uh... Yes, sure.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: There's no need to drag this out. I'll just make this quick.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I already heard from Andersen.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You want access to the Nikke production technology?
That's right.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What are you going to do with it?
I plan to hand it over to Eden.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Eden?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So you wish to become a traitor?
No.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Then why should we give the Ark's technology to Eden, who isn't cooperative?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: And of all things, the most classified Nikke production technology?
Because I believe it'll be necessary for the battles ahead.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Something overwhelmingly powerful attacked Eden.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Some, or perhaps even most, of Eden's Nikkes have survived with only their brains intact.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: For Eden to suffer damage this close to annihilation...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: then the enemy was likely the Queen, or something of her caliber.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Fine, I'll give you the Nikke production technology.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: But I have one condition.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Eliminate Sixo,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: the mastermind behind the recent E2 Crystal terrorist attack in the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Do that, and the Nikke production technology will be yours.
I was planning to take her out anyway.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hmm. You'd better watch your words.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That statement of yours has just erased any reason for me to hand over the Nikke production technology.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What are you thinking, throwing away your own bargaining chip in the middle of a negotiation?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Consider this a simple piece of advice. Be more careful from now on.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The terms of our agreement remain unchanged, so carry out your duties properly.
Understood.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Is there something else you want to tell me?
I'd like to talk about Marian, but I won't.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's no different from having said it.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So, do you resent me

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: for trying to put your precious comrade on the lab table by any means necessary?
Yes.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I see.
I get where you're coming from.
But even so, there are some things I just can't back down from.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Did you ever stop to think why I didn't order a pursuit

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: when the Heretic Modernia was taken to the surface so blatantly?
I figured it was because the surface was dangerous.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I was personally curious about how far you could go.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I wondered what would happen if I left a willful commander like you

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: entirely to your own devices.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Fortunately, you've performed exceptionally well since then, and it has once again reinforced my confidence in my own judgment.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I trust you.
Why... me...?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: For one thing, there's the matter with my son...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: And...
A flicker of exhaustion suddenly crosses Deputy Chief Burningum's face.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I always wanted to be a commander.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It was my dream ever since I was a child.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I longed to fight alongside the Nikkes on the surface and to lay down my life for the Ark and for humanity.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: But my father was an extraordinary man, and my grandfather even more so.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: As the heir to their legacy, I couldn't set foot on the surface,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: especially as the only child of such a remarkable family.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So, I gave up on becoming a commander.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Instead, I took a high-ranking position in the Central Government, leading people with nothing more than gestures and nods.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I suppose I did fairly well. After all, I made it all the way to the rank of deputy chief.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: But...
He stares at me
exactly like he did the first time I entered this room.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I never stopped wanting to be a commander...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: a commander like you.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Just by watching, it feels like you can handle just about anything, as an ideal commander should.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's who I want to be.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You are both my idol and the one I envy.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's why I trust you, and why I've kept tabs on you.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Go all the way to the end.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Keep shining. Remain my idol.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Go as far as you can,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: but I'll be right there to watch you fall too.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: So I guess it's fair to say these two feelings live within me.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hmm... I say the strangest things, don't I?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I've been looking forward to having a chance to talk with you, so I end up saying everything that's on my mind.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Let's change the subject, shall we?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: How's Papillon doing?
As far as I can tell,
she looks like she's doing really well.
It might take a little time, but she said she'd return later with plenty of information.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Next time you see her,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: tell her to submit her resignation letter.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We have no use for spies who think they're the masters of their own lives.
... Will do.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: And also...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No, this won't do... I'm going to be up all night at this rate.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Might as well get up now.
I get up from my chair, bewildered.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Right, before you go...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Sign this document.
Is this some kind of confidentiality agreement?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No. My son, who's indebted to you, said he wanted your signature.
Isn't that usually called an autograph?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Fine, call it what you will.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: And sign this too.
This is...?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It's for my private collection.
